statement.zh: 以之为生与世系使关系项直接相关：它们是只有一类读法才提供的两种 related，在依存网的逐步读法上各自加在交互之上，living（活跃且不侵蚀）保持不变。
statement.en: Living on and descent relate relata directly: they are two readings of related that only the one-kind reading supplies, each added to interaction on the stepwise reading of a web, with living (active and not undermining) kept.

laws.zh: 以之为生：一个形成在某步汲取一个关系项、并以正需要依存于它；这样的事件与该关系项的事件相关。
laws.en: Living on: a formation draws at a step on a relatum and depends on it at a positive need there, and such an event is related to that relatum's events.

laws.zh: 以之为生与交互一样需要实际的汲取与能落空的依存：在 Dependent 之下，活跃的形成以之为生的关系项在该步作为条件而在，该关系项体现时也在该步活跃。
laws.en: Like interaction, living on needs an actual drawing and a dependence that can fail: under Dependent the relatum an active formation lives on stands at that step, and where that relatum is embodied it is active there.

laws.zh: 以之为生使只依存于对方的蜂与花连通，而共同参与与交互都不连通它们。
laws.en: Living on connects a bee and a flower that depend only on each other, which neither co-participation nor interaction connects.

laws.zh: 在 N_rel 之下，珍视一个以某关系项为生的事件，就珍视该关系项的每个活的事件，反之亦然：珍视狐的进食，就到达兔的活。
laws.en: Under N_rel, valuing an event that lives on a relatum reaches every living event of that relatum, and conversely: valuing the fox's eating reaches the hare's living.

laws.zh: 世系：一个关系项从一个形成而来，当后者参与某步、在该步给予它，而它跨该步开始作为条件而在；不参与的形成的给予项不进入任何水平，不造成世系；世系使两个关系项的每个事件相关。
laws.en: Descent: a relatum descends from a formation that takes part in a step at which it gives to the relatum and across which the relatum comes to stand; a give entry of a formation taking no part enters no level and makes no descent; and descent relates every event of the one relatum to every event of the other.

laws.zh: 在平衡且只有活跃形成给予的流中，生起的体现关系项从在该步活跃的另一个形成而来，这个形成不必体现；于是在 N_rel 之下，珍视这个形成的任一事件，就到达由它而来的关系项的每个活的事件，反之亦然。
laws.en: In a balanced flow in which only active formations give, an embodied relatum that arises descends from another formation active at that step, which need not be embodied; so under N_rel, valuing any event of that formation reaches every living event of the relatum descending from it, and conversely.

laws.zh: 世代各由前一代给予时，世系使它们连通，共同参与与交互都不连通它们，G0 在那里恰等于种子加 N_rel 加 N_std。
laws.en: Generations each given by the one before are connected by descent and by neither co-participation nor interaction, and G0 there is exactly a seed with N_rel and N_std.

laws.zh: 世系跟着开始作为条件而在走，不跟着生起走：种子从在它休眠时供给它的父代而来，从休眠中醒来不从任何形成而来。
laws.en: Descent follows coming to stand, not arising: a seed descends from the parent that provisioned it while dormant, and waking from dormancy descends from nothing.

laws.zh: 两种读法都用到哪个条件就是哪个关系项：把只依存于对方的蜂与花的条件互换，共同参与与交互的连通不变（都不连通），以之为生的连通由有变无。
laws.en: Both readings use which condition is which relatum: relabelling the conditions of the bee and the flower that depend only on each other, each onto the other, leaves the connection of co-participation and interaction as it was (none) and removes the connection by living on.

hypotheses.zh: 一类关系项的读法：条件与形成共用索引，哪个条件就是哪个关系项由共同的索引给出（relabel，见 life-as-condition-of-life）。两种关系的定义都不含体现：进入估值的是这一同一对应，不是体现；体现只进入 Embodied.descends 与 arisen_reached 的结论。
hypotheses.en: The one-kind reading: conditions and formations share an index, and which condition is which relatum is supplied by the shared index (relabel, see life-as-condition-of-life). Neither definition mentions embodiment: what enters the valuation is this identification, not embodiment, which enters only the conclusions of Embodied.descends and arisen_reached.

hypotheses.zh: sustenance 与 descent 是 related 的两种读法，是对应前提：依 Ren 的交托决定，在用到该补全时它们算作 N_rel 所传递的形成关系，不作为直接的估值。N_rel 本身仍是前提（metaethical-core-characterization），在到达之律中是前件；本记录不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理。
hypotheses.en: sustenance and descent are two readings of related, correspondence premises: decided on Ren's delegation, they count as formed relations along which N_rel transmits where that completion is used, not as direct valuations. N_rel itself remains a premise (metaethical-core-characterization), an antecedent of the reaching laws; the record uses no ethical premise and no Lean axiom.

hypotheses.zh: Embodied.descends 与 arisen_reached 需要流平衡依存网、只有活跃形成给予（Acting），以及生起的关系项体现。
hypotheses.en: Embodied.descends and arisen_reached need the flow to balance the web, only active formations to give (Acting), and the arising relatum to be embodied.

hypotheses.zh: LivesOn.stands 需要 Dependent；LivesOn.active 另需以之为生的关系项体现。
hypotheses.en: LivesOn.stands needs Dependent; LivesOn.active also needs the relatum lived on to be embodied.

does_not_show.zh: 不改变 living，不改变 C，不推出生起是好的或应当带来新的生起。
does_not_show.en: Changes neither living nor C, and does not show that arising is good or that new arising ought to be brought about.

does_not_show.zh: 只对逐步读法陈述；世系使两个关系项的所有事件相关，不排定时间。
does_not_show.en: Stated for the stepwise reading only; descent relates every event of two relata and does not order them in time.

does_not_show.zh: 给予的形成不必体现：源给予种子也是世系。
does_not_show.en: The formation that gives need not be embodied: a source giving to a seed is descent too.

does_not_show.zh: 以之为生不问汲取的效果。
does_not_show.en: Living on does not ask about the effect of drawing.

does_not_show.zh: 世系按给予项计，不按净流量：给予又取回同样多的参与者也是祖先，这是又一个读法选择。
does_not_show.en: Descent counts give entries, not net flow: a formation taking part that gives and takes back as much is still an ancestor, a further choice of reading.

does_not_show.zh: 两种读法都依赖一类读法的同一对应，两类读法检查不到它。
does_not_show.en: Both readings depend on the one-kind identification, which the two-kind readings cannot check.

detail.zh: 世代各由前一代给予：共同参与与交互都不连通它们，世系连通它们（Brood.descended）。
detail.en: Generations each given by the one before: neither co-participation nor interaction connects them, descent does (Brood.descended).

detail.zh: 哪个条件就是哪个关系项进入以之为生：把只依存于对方的蜂与花的条件互换，共同参与与交互不变，以之为生的连通消失（Mutualism.relabel_sustenance）。
detail.en: Which condition is which relatum enters living on: relabelling the conditions of the bee and the flower that depend only on each other, each onto the other, leaves co-participation and interaction unchanged and removes the connection by living on (Mutualism.relabel_sustenance).

detail.zh: 从休眠中醒来不从任何形成而来，而生成不息（Sleeper.no_descent）；种子从休眠时供给它的父代而来，生起时没有给予（Provisioned.descends）。
detail.en: Waking from dormancy descends from nothing while generation is unceasing (Sleeper.no_descent); a seed descends from the parent that provisioned it while dormant and is given nothing when it arises (Provisioned.descends).

detail.zh: 以之为生的关系项不必体现，也不必活跃：在 Dependent 之下，吃者以一个休眠时仍作为条件而在的关系项为生；以之为生使两者连通，交互不连通（Drowsy.drowsy）。
detail.en: The relatum lived on need be neither embodied nor active: under Dependent an eater lives on a relatum that stands while dormant; living on connects the two, interaction does not (Drowsy.drowsy).

detail.zh: 不参与的形成的给予项不造成世系：流平衡且只有活跃形成给予，无关的关系项对种子的给予项在种子开始作为条件而在之步为正，种子只从参与的父代而来（Unrelated.unrelated）；Brood 的第一代不从第八代而来（Brood.not_descends）。
detail.en: The give entry of a formation taking no part makes no descent: the flow balances and only active formations give, the unrelated relatum's give entry to a seed is positive at the step across which the seed comes to stand, and the seed descends from the parent taking part alone (Unrelated.unrelated); in Brood the first generation does not descend from the eighth (Brood.not_descends).

next_delta.en: An ordered, effect-sensitive living on; the transitive closure of descent (ancestry) and descent within finitely many steps; the same relations for the whole-run reading; connecting to universal_reason's ‘new living content’.

correspondence.zh: Becoming.Metaethics 把 related 读作形成的关系，列出条件、依存、世系与合作；此前的读法只经由共同的条件相关，life-as-condition-of-life 记下“直接读出体现的估值”为下一步，Mutualism.apart 是其反例：蜂与花都体现、互相依存，却不相关。本结果在一类读法中给出两种直接的关系：以之为生对应条件化与依存，世系对应世系。以之为生要求正需要的依存，沿用交互的纪律（连通由活的使用造成）；世系要求参与该步的形成正的给予与开始作为条件而在。Ren 的原话是“生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向”。在把体现的关系项读作“生”这一读法下（整合文档 §23 K6；依 Ren 的交托采用，DELEGATED-CHOICES D4），作者把世系读作原话中两个“生”之间关系的一种形式内容：生起者由给予它的展开而来，并经由世系与整体相关（AI 论证）；这不替代原话；以之为生与世系依 Ren 的交托采用，作为延续的已形成关系，不作为直接的估值（DELEGATED-CHOICES D9）。
correspondence.en: Becoming.Metaethics reads related as formed relation: conditioning, dependence, descent and cooperation; the earlier readings relate only through a shared condition, life-as-condition-of-life records ‘a valuation reading embodiment directly’ as a next step, and Mutualism.apart is its counterexample: a bee and a flower, both embodied and depending on each other, are unrelated. This result gives two direct relations in the one-kind reading: living on corresponds to conditioning and dependence, descent to descent. Living on requires dependence at a positive need, keeping interaction's discipline that connection is made by living use; descent requires a positive gift from a formation taking part in the step and coming to stand. Ren's words are “生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向” (a whole direction of unceasingly creating more 生). Taking embodied relata as 生, a reading adopted on Ren's delegation (integration note §23, K6; DELEGATED-CHOICES D4), the author reads descent as one formal content of the relation between the two 生 in those words: what arises comes from the unfolding that gives it, and is related to the whole through descent (an AI argument); it does not replace Ren's words; living on and descent are adopted on Ren's delegation as formed relations of continuation, not as direct valuations (DELEGATED-CHOICES D9).

detail.zh: 复用交互（Interacts、Bearing、interaction）与连通的转移；以之为生沿用“依存须能落空”的纪律。
detail.en: Reuses interaction (Interacts, Bearing, interaction) and the transfer of connection; living on keeps the discipline that the dependence must be able to fail.

output.zh: 只有交互经由条件相关；连通由活的使用造成。
output.en: Only interaction relates through a condition; connection is made by living use.

input.zh: 交互之外，以之为生与世系直接关联关系项。
input.en: Beyond interaction, living on and descent relate relata directly.

conditions.zh: 一类读法；正需要的依存；参与该步的形成正的给予与开始作为条件而在。
conditions.en: The one-kind reading; dependence at a positive need; a positive gift from a formation taking part and coming to stand.

detail.zh: 复用一类读法、Embodied、arises_given、active_of_bearing、relabel、Brood 与 Mutualism.apart；以更宽的形式回答其下一步“直接读出体现的估值”：两种关系的定义不含体现。
detail.en: Reuses the one-kind reading, Embodied, arises_given, active_of_bearing, relabel, Brood and Mutualism.apart; answers its next step ‘a valuation reading embodiment directly’ in a broader form: neither relation's definition mentions embodiment.

output.zh: 体现的关系项只经由另一个活跃形成的给予而生起；只依存于对方的蜂与花在两种估值下不相关。
output.en: An embodied relatum arises only as another active formation gives to it; a bee and a flower depending only on each other are unrelated under both valuations.

input.zh: 生起的体现关系项从给予它的形成而来并与之相关；以之为生使蜂与花相关。
input.en: An arising embodied relatum descends from and is related to the formation that gives to it; living on relates the bee and the flower.

detail.zh: 复用开始作为条件而在（ComesToStand、Embodied.comesToStand）以及 Provisioned 与 Sleeper；世系跟着开始作为条件而在走。
detail.en: Reuses coming to stand (ComesToStand, Embodied.comesToStand) and Provisioned and Sleeper; descent follows coming to stand.

output.zh: 开始作为条件而在需要给予；体现的关系项在生起时开始作为条件而在。
output.en: Coming to stand needs giving; an embodied relatum comes to stand as it arises.

input.zh: 世系：参与该步的形成给予，关系项跨该步开始作为条件而在。
input.en: Descent: a formation taking part gives as the relatum comes to stand.

detail.zh: 复用 Valuation、N_rel（transmits）与 significant_iff：连通的整体上 G0 恰等于种子加两种中立。
detail.en: Reuses Valuation, N_rel (transmits) and significant_iff: on a connected whole G0 is exactly a seed with both neutralities.

output.zh: 连通的整体上 G0 的刻画。
output.en: G0's characterization on a connected whole.

input.zh: 世系使世代连通，于是刻画适用。
input.en: Descent connects the generations, so the characterization applies.

detail.zh: 同一批见证（Provisioned、Sleeper）区分水平与活动；世系跟着水平走。
detail.en: The same witnesses (Provisioned, Sleeper) separate standing and activity; descent follows standing.

detail.zh: C 的排序随读法而变；这里只改变 related，不改变 living，所以 C 的比较不变，变的是 N_rel 传递到哪里。
detail.en: C's ranking varies with the reading; here only related changes, not living, so C's comparisons are unchanged and what changes is where N_rel transmits.

history.zh: 2026-10-14 迁移到 schema 2（开放问题计划 F 项：lint 发现最多的 45 条 schema-1 记录的迁移；Ren：“please, do all”，经整合会话转达）：长标题改为短名“以之为生与世系”，原标题的内容成为陈述，连同主张的第一句（逐步读法、保留 living、加在交互之上）；主张拆为 9 条规律；限制分入“未表明”、前提与通用边界；证据成为一段。“它与交互一样不是免费的：它需要……”中“不是免费的”（市场词）改为直接说它需要什么（“与交互一样需要实际的汲取与能落空的依存”），内容是原句冒号后的部分。“不用伦理前提，也不用 Lean 公理”留在前提中，与“N_rel 本身仍是前提”同列，并写明 N_rel 是到达之律的前件；没有引用通用边界 no-ethical-premise，因为 N_rel 是规范前提（见 metaethical-core-characterization），该键的引用条件要求前提中没有伦理前提。对应中“两种关系的定义都不含体现”一句移入一类读法的前提，“所以不由空的给予或不参与者的给予项造成”由规律 5 承担，“不推出生起是好的”由“未表明”第一项承担。规律、前提、状态、证明绑定与来源哈希均未改变。每句旧文本的去向见迁移对照表 [living-on-and-descent.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/living-on-and-descent.md)；迁移前的完整记录为 text_versions 末项。
history.en: 14 October 2026, migrated to schema 2 (item F of the open-issues plan: the migration of the 45 schema-1 records with the most lint findings; Ren: “please, do all”, relayed by the integrating session): the long title became the short name “Living on and descent”, its content now the statement together with the claim's first sentence (the stepwise reading, living kept, each relation added to interaction); the claim became 9 laws; the limitations went to does-not-show items, hypotheses and standard boundaries; the evidence became one paragraph. “Like interaction it is not free: it needs …” now says directly what it needs (“Like interaction, living on needs an actual drawing and a dependence that can fail”), the content of the old sentence after its colon; the zh 不是免费的 was a market word. “No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used” stays in the hypotheses, next to “N_rel itself remains a premise”, which now says that N_rel is an antecedent of the reaching laws; the shared key no-ethical-premise is not cited, because N_rel is a normative premise (see metaethical-core-characterization) and the key is cited only where the hypotheses hold no ethical premise. In the correspondence, the sentence that neither definition mentions embodiment moved to the one-kind hypothesis, “so neither empty giving nor the give entry of a formation taking no part makes it” is carried by law 5, and “does not show that arising is good” by the first does-not-show item. No law, premise, status, proof binding or source hash changed. Every earlier sentence is mapped in the migration table [living-on-and-descent.md](../../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/development/becoming-general-laws-plan/readability/migrations/living-on-and-descent.md); the exact earlier record is the last text_versions entry.
